name: 11b-convert-mistral-messages
description: convertMistralMessages (prompt-converters.js:703-777) on a full tool-using prompt with `mistral.enablePrefix` ON -- the config block matters, because that value is read at CALL time (:709), not at import time like PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER. Four rules are pinned here: (1) the last assistant turn gets `prefix: true` (:711-713) -- and here the last turn is a SYSTEM turn, so the prefix lands on the assistant turn before it, which is what distinguishes the guard's `lastMsg` from 'some assistant turn'; (2) every tool_call id and tool_call_id is replaced by the first 9 hex chars of its sha512 (:715, :719-726); (3) `example_assistant` / `example_user` system turns lose their `name` and gain a prefix, while a non-system named turn gains the 'name: ' prefix and then loses `name` (:727-744); (4) `fixToolMessages` (:748-766) is a FIXPOINT loop -- each pass folds an immediately-following user turn into the last non-empty user turn before the tool turn and splices it out, then re-runs, so the two trailing user turns collapse one at a time and the `i === length - 1` early return stops the scan. The final pass (:770-774) then turns the assistant-followed-by-system pair into a user turn.
